scope: Local macOS arm64 ordinary production RTC/WebRTC libraries, actual engine answers to saved complete Chrome/Firefox offers, unit and retained Core component checks. No connected browser, signed WSS/Store, full Connect rebuild, clock/sync/fallback/hosting/package or Gate6 acceptance claim.
implementation: Codec identity matching treats Opus/VP8 receive preferences separately from MIME/rate/channels; H264 format identity and RTX association remain enforced.

Local SDP advertises locally registered receive parameters while negotiated RTP sender parameters retain original remote receiver constraints. Dynamic payload IDs, RTX apt, MID and directions are preserved.
Opus stereo=1 is a receive preference, while the fixed Core sender remains mono and rejects actual stereo or non-20ms packets.

VP8 independently validates both receive capacities against 640x360 (920 macroblocks) at 30fps. Duplicate, malformed, insufficient or overflowing known limits refuse; unknown extension parameters are ignored. Explicit bounded host advertises its own limits.
